name: Pope Still Hunt Camp (Apalachicola National Forest)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A bare clearing in the pines with no toilets, water or tables, mapped on Forest Highway 13. It is the nearest listed free Forest Service camp found for the Nov 26-27 Wakulla Springs / Leon Sinks stop.
access: No reservation needed. Stay limit: 14 days per month (National Forests in Florida) Derived, not read from the 2026-27 brochure (FWC brochure app errored): rule text says general gun is 'the first 58 days of Zone D antlered deer season'; with FWC's 2026-27 Zone D dates that is Nov 26-29, 2026 and Dec 12, 2026 - Feb 3, 2027. Rule: on National Forest lands camping is 'only on designated campsites during general gun season', so on Nov 26-29 roadside dispersed camping in Apalachicola NF is not legal and a listed hunt camp or campground is the legal choice. Small game season opens the second Saturday of November outside general gun days. Orange requirement not checked; expect armed hunters in camp over Thanksgiving weekend.
